tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bdud 'dul mchod rten nyams gso skabs kyi 'dod gsol bzhugs so// shing glang bdud 'dul mchod rten nyams gso bgyis skabs 'dod gsol phul bar/ rgyal ba'i thugs rten 'di bzhengs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas shākya seng ge'i bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag 'khrul med sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas par gyur cig de 'dzin gyi skyes bu spyi dang bye brag rnams zhabs pad brtan zhing chos kyi bya bas dus 'da' bar༞ dge 'dun gyi sde 'dis mtshon phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun pa rnams thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba sogs chos mthun gyi bya ba rnams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par༞ yul phyogs 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du char chu dus su 'bab cing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang nad yams mu ge dmag 'khrug la sogs pa rnams dus rtag tu mi 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur༞ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la gegs su gyur pa phyi rol gdon bgegs kyi gnod pa dang༞ nang 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi gnod pa dang / gsang ba sems nyid gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog 'khrul pa la sogs pa'i gnod pa rnams mi 'byung zhing rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bzang po rnams yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas te/ ci byas bstan 'gro'i don du 'gro ba'i rgyur gyur cig khyad par rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bstan dgra rnams kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams zhi zhing rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bkur bsti bya ba'i bsam pa dang ldan par gyur cig rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung nor lha yis/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /yid la re ba'i 'dod don kun 'grub shog/ //oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/

sa skya pa kun blos lhag bsam dag pas sbyar/ yi ge pa ni bsod 'od kyis bgyis pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ bdud 'dul mchod rten nyams gso skabs kyi 'dod gsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
